files.README.md:
# Vantage ALPR Reference Pack

Apache-2.0 synthetic ALPR Solution Pack v2 for Gate West 01 (SR-0100, TEST-742).
files.vantage_pipelines/alpr-vehicle-plate.jso:
{
  "pipeline_id": "io.serviceradar.vantage-alpr.vehicle-plate",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "name": "ALPR Vehicle Plate Reader",
  "description": "Extracts synthetic license plate reads on vehicle detections at Gate West 01.",
  "enabled": true,
  "source_mode": "recorded_block",
  "trigger_kind": "on_stage1_detection",
  "camera_selector": "tag:gate-entry",
  "object_classes": [
    "vehicle"
  ],
  "min_confidence": 0.55,
  "roi_polygons": [
    [
      [
        0.05,
        0.2
      ],
      [
        0.95,
        0.2
      ],
      [
        0.95,
        0.95
      ],
      [
        0.05,
        0.95
      ]
    ]
  ],
  "input_mode": "detection_crop",
  "crop_policy": {
    "padding_ratio": 0.15,
    "min_bbox_width_px": 96,
    "max_dimension": 640,
    "max_bytes": 98304
  },
  "max_jobs_per_minute": 60,
  "max_frames_per_track": 3,
  "runner": "camera_vlm",
  "capability": "vantage.alpr.v1",
  "fallback_runner": "camera_vlm",
  "vlm_config": {
    "prompt": "Read the synthetic vehicle license plate and return strict JSON with plate_text, region, vehicle_color, and vehicle_type.",
    "model_profile": "vantage-vlm-fast",
    "max_tokens": 256,
    "temperature": 0.0
  },
  "signal_schema_id": "alpr_plate_read",
  "signal_schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "display_contract_id": "alpr_plate_read",
  "emit_ocsf_events": true,
  "live_observation_retention_days": 30
}
